name: @sand/loops
description: Runs each turn in a shared frame and hands it to the agent loop chosen for the thread

sand.label: Agent loops
sand.summary: Runs turns with the loop chosen for each thread

uses.ui: there is no /loop command and loop fallbacks are not announced
uses.server: the page cannot list or choose loops
uses.sessions: the page cannot choose loops and /loop needs an open thread
uses.modelSettings: a thread that /loop starts ignores the model picked in the composer
uses.transcript: loop changes are not shown in the thread
